meta.title: Digital Club – AI, agents and digital solutions that actually ship
meta.description: Digital Club helps organisations implement AI, roll out AI agents across the business, and build the digital solutions they need – with or without AI.
hero.lead: Digital Club turns ideas into working software. From your first AI pilot to agents running across the whole organisation – and the solutions where AI isn't the answer at all.
services.title: Three ways we help
services.lead: Pick the one that fits – or start with a chat and we'll work it out together.
s1.title: AI Implementation
s1.tagline: You think the product, we help implement it.
s1.body: Bring the idea; we bring the engineering. We shape it into a product, choose the right models and data, and deliver something your users can rely on – secure, measurable and maintainable.
s1.p1: Product discovery and proof of concept
s1.p2: Integration with your systems and data
s2.title: Agent Implementation
s2.tagline: We can all create agents. Rolling them out across an organisation is what we specialise in.
s2.body: A demo agent takes an afternoon. Agents that work for hundreds of people – with the right permissions, audit trail, monitoring and support – take experience. That's where we come in.
s3.title: Not Everything is AI
s3.tagline: Not everyone wants AI – and that's fine.
s3.body: Sometimes the best answer is a well-built app, a clean integration or a simple automation. If you need a digital solution, talk to us – we'll recommend what actually solves the problem.
products.title: Software we build and run
products.lead: Products born from real client problems, available to everyone.
p.elistings.title: eListings
p.elistings.body: Turn supplier catalogues into profitable eBay listings. Import products, see true profit after fees, publish in bulk and track every sale.
p.next.title: More products on the way
p.next.body: We're building new tools for sellers and growing businesses. Tell us what you need – it might be next.
approach.title: Straightforward, from first call to go-live
a1.title: Listen
a1.body: We start with your goals, your people and your constraints – not a technology.
a2.title: Prove
a2.body: A small, working proof of value in weeks, so decisions are based on evidence.
a3.title: Deliver
a3.body: Production-ready software, rolled out carefully, with the people who'll use it.
a4.title: Support
a4.body: We stay with you: monitoring, improvements and help when you need it.
contact.title: Let's talk about what you need
contact.lead: Tell us a little about your idea or problem. We'll get back to you within two working days.
contact.name: Your name
contact.consent: I agree that Digital Club may use these details to reply to my enquiry.
contact.sent: Thank you – your message has been sent. We'll be in touch soon.
contact.error: Sorry, your message couldn't be sent. Please try again or email us directly.
contact.invalid: Please fill in your name, a valid email address and a message, and tick the consent box.
privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: We only use the details you send through the contact form to reply to your enquiry. We don't sell or share them, and we delete them when they're no longer needed. To see, correct or delete your details, email us.
footer.tagline: AI, agents and digital solutions that actually ship.
